correctness.rationale: The incidence constraints are regular zero-set sections of E=⊕_six λ_e^∨ in oriented ambient R^8×(RP1)^6, using original Olberding–Walker Lemma3.1; Whitney sum gives w1(TQ)=Σw1(λ_e). For connected G=Sim^+(R²), equivariant determinant and vertical Lie algebra orientation descend this to w1(TB)=Σu_e without wrongly relying on injectivity of pullback. For each edge ij, hold vi=vj=0, vk=(1,0),vl=(0,1); their three connecting lines form a nondegenerate triangle for every direction of the free ij-line, so rotating that RP1 gives a genuine closed loop. Exactly its tautological λ_ij is Möbius and the other five are fixed/trivial: six-by-six mod-2 evaluation matrix identity. Therefore six classes independent and the sum is nonzero; both quotient and upstairs nonorientable, dim H1>=6. Checked collision admissibility (no triple coincident) and freely oriented group quotient.

originality.rationale: Olberding–Walker original full primary (Definition2.1, Lemma3.1, quotient theorem and invariant sections) proves smoothness and constructs moduli, but the inspected paper does not derive six independent first Stiefel–Whitney classes, orientation obstruction or collision-loop duality. Martin graph picture-space analogs address incidence varieties over projective fields, not mod-two orientation characteristic classes of this real Nash quotient. Resultary nearest geometry hits concern different moduli. Best-of-knowledge originality PASS for explicit six-dimensional H1 subspace/first SW computation, not for constructing the manifold.
residual_risks: Unindexed incidence-bundle orientation results might give the w1 formula in a broader setting, but a broader theorem would need a separate six-independent-loop verification.

value.rationale: Computing the orientation character and six explicit independent H1 generators is an exact intrinsic topological invariant of a naturally defined moduli space, constraining orientation, cohomology and possible further classification.
